71025.synopsis:
At the age of 12, Shen Yue accidentally fell into a pond while feeding fish. That’s when she realized that her parents were not her real parents, and her five brothers were not her real brothers either. She was just a fake heiress to the Shen family!
Knowing she was destined to lose everything, Shen Yue decided to just lie down and give up. If she was going to lose it all anyway, she might as well just lie down and relax.
“Big brother, is working at the company fun? Let me check it out,” she thought, wanting to enjoy the perks of being a Shen daughter while she still could. Those luxuries would be out of reach soon enough.
“Second brother, is acting fun? Let me give it a try,” she schemed. What? They pay you just to lie still like a corpse? This is a job she had to get!
“Third brother, is that gun realistic? Let me see,” she said, examining the firearm. Not bad, though the recoil is too strong. She’d need to find a smaller one to play with next time.
“Fourth brother, will the teachers be mad if I sneak into your research institute? Let me take a peek,” she plotted, eyeing her handsome professor. A little hugging wouldn’t hurt!
“Fifth brother, that medicine you’re working on smells nice. Mind if I try a little taste…” she asked casually before sampling it. Tastes good! But now my head feels itchy—I better not be growing a brain!
On the day the real heiress returned, Shen Yue’s five brothers shielded her behind them. “Dear sister, can we keep her with us? She’s a bit slow, it’d be dangerous for her out there alone.”
The true heiress scoffed coldly, masking her sly intentions beneath a guise of innocence.
But in the end, she realized this Shen Yue really was quite dim-witted. Oh well, might as well let her stay.

78193.synopsis:
In just one year, Laina City lost eight lords due to various natural and man-made disasters, earning a terrifying reputation among the nobility as ‘the cursed land’.
And this infamously cursed city finally welcomed a new lord before the end of spring, who possessed dazzling golden hair like the sun and an angelic, delicate face that always bore a smile.
As soon as Oliver opened his eyes, he was faced with this vast and barren land, and fearful and frail serfs.
Looking further, he saw his skills reset to zero, a low quality backpack with only basic tools and a few sets of seeds.
Oliver silently looked at the mud-like, hard-to-swallow bean soup, then at the gray, locked list of items, falling deep into thought.
Before long, the people of Laina were terrified to discover that this seemingly delicate golden-haired beauty was actually a construction fanatic who would rise early every day and faint beside the road at night, only to miraculously return full of energy the next day.
Emotional Ver. of Plot Text:
To find a legitimate source for the items obtained through the game system…
Oliver had a stroke of cunning insight – boldly using a statue from his backpack as a deity idol, taking advantage of his territory’s remote location and the rarity of outside visitors.
Although it was risky to create his own ‘god’, it indeed provided perfect cover for the “miracles” he displayed.
However, he didn’t know that because the people in his territory loved him too much, they sincerely regarded the statue as a god and worshipped it day in and day out.
As time went by, the statue that had eventually absorbed enough faith to gain divinity and become a true god.
—And this newly born deity deeply loved the beautiful lord who not only created him but also brought him fresh flowers every day with a smile when he was still vague in consciousness.
*Note: This text contains extensive descriptions of the protagonist’s appearance, emphasizing his beauty. The author enjoys this style and will not change it.
*The main character is the bottom in a 1V1 relationship, featuring original game skills + items in a fantasy world. The game is inspired by “Stardew Valley” (also known as “Liver Valley”).
*No historical accuracy, the entire text is the author’s fabrication.

78449.synopsis:
Asuru, the third prince of the Lombard Kingdom, asserts, based on his meticulous research, the existence of relics from a super-ancient civilization in the foreboding “Land of Death.”
Despite his fervent beliefs, his father, the king, deems his claims as sheer lunacy and, seeking to rid himself of Asuru, banishes him to this cursed territory as a form of exile.
However, Asuru refuses to surrender to despair.
Five years later, his relentless determination bears fruit as he uncovers the elusive relic, assuming mastery over its power.
Harnessing the advanced technology of a bygone galactic civilization, he breathes new life into the desolate “Land of Death,” transforming it into a verdant haven. Moreover, he extends an open hand to the beastmen, a marginalized race from a neighboring land.
Thus, from the ashes of exile, emerges a nation boasting the largest expanse of land on the continent, forged by Asuru’s unwavering vision and ingenuity.

83057.synopsis:
Hua Yan was the holy maiden of a demonic sect, commonly known as a demoness.
Due to the notorious deeds of her predecessors, she had already gained a bad reputation before even stepping out of her home.
Heaven knows, she is a good person!
Now, she was staying beside Lu Chengsha, the so-called strongest force in the righteous path in the last hundred years, known in the demonic sect as the “Human Killing God.” She was constantly worried that her identity would be exposed, leading to her being torn to pieces by this sworn enemy.
However, she didn’t want to leave at all.
Lu Chengsha drew his sword, expressionless, and said, “I will protect you and kill all the people of the demonic sect.”
Demoness Hua Yan: “…Thank you.”〒▽〒
————
Hua Yan was a demoness who grew up in an environment full of love, with affectionate parents, childhood friends, and a loving upbringing.
Lu Chengsha was the complete opposite.
He had no emotions, no hobbies, no friends.

But in Hua Yan’s eyes, he was the ideal human, full of righteousness, a perfect hero.

84081.synopsis:
Jiang Chen travels to a fantasy novel world and becomes the villainous senior brother.
He didn’t have any golden finger (cheat) and didn’t want to end up as villainous cannon fodder, so he repeated nine reincarnation cycles, only aiming to be an upright senior brother.
Yet fate is unjust, bestowing upon him the aura of a villain, causing him to suffer countless misunderstandings and disdain.
Until the ‘Tenth Life’!
In this life, Jiang Chen gave up. His heart grew cold, and he also finally let himself go.
Jiang Chen: “Since heaven wants me to be a villain, why should I defy it?”
……
My name is Jiang Lianyue, and I have a villainous senior brother who is despicable.
I despise him, detest him, and even wish he would die quickly!
But one day, I witnessed a flashback of nine lifetimes…
In the first life, my senior brother sacrificed his own core to help the second brother rebuild his core, damaging his own foundation in the process.
In the second life, I was afflicted with a cold poison, and my senior brother, with his modest cultivation, refined pills for a hundred days to cure me at the cost of destroying his own core.
In the third life, I finally understood everything…

85361.synopsis:

Among these numerous villains, he was particularly notable.
―Shall we now try to seduce the Goddess of Fate?
To prevent a disaster from befalling his country, the king takes the gamble of a lifetime. However, what awaits him is an unforeseen emotion he hadn’t even anticipated by 0.1 percent.
“Turn my love into a handful of ashes.”

86897.synopsis:
For three years, there was a saying at City No. 1 High School: “No. 1 at City High is Wang Xiaoqi, while Xu Yinong is perpetually second.”
One evening after a self-study session, Xu Yinong was doing cleaning duty alone and was focused on sweeping the floor. When she straightened up, she saw the “No. 1” leaning against the classroom door frame watching her.
Xu Yinong: “What are you looking at? Stop showing off.”
Wang Xiaoqi smiled, “I’m not doing anything.”
She continued sweeping, her tone unfriendly, “Move your feet!”
Wang Xiaoqi stepped aside, “I’ve always outperformed you on exams, so how about I treat you to a meal to make up for it?”
Xu Yinong’s attention shifted slightly, “You’re making up for it?”
“Then how about you make up for it by accepting me as your boyfriend after the college entrance exam?”
“……”
Many years later, when they met again, she was the team leader for the client side and he was the project manager for the service provider side.
One day, his team was discussing the client team leader’s exceptional looks and elegance – especially her figure.
Wang Xiaoqi, after hanging up the landline phone, interrupted, “You all seem to have a lot of free time?”
Later, Wang Xiaoqi and Xu Yinong ran into each other in the break room.
“Manager Xu, don’t you have any loose shirts for your female employees?”
Xu Yinong: “Manager Wang, what do you mean by that?”
Wang Xiaoqi leaned against the door frame, lazily as he did years ago, “What do you think?”
Xu Yinong, unimpressed, retorted, “Manager Wang, is this how you talk to your clients?”
“Then, dear client, what role do you think suits me?” Wang Xiaoqi smiled, “Ex-boyfriend?”
“……”
One sentence summary: “The fire in my heart will never go out. If it goes out, I can reignite it.” —Stephen Chow
* Mutual unspoken love from school to the workplace. First love reunites after a long separation and a broken mirror is made whole again.
* Primarily set in the workplace featuring two strong leads. Professional terminology in the workplace sections will be explained in author notes.
* The dialogue in the blurb has context, please do not misinterpret. Thank you.

89457.synopsis:
“Correction, I was not forced! I did this voluntarily!”
Genius investor Bai Xu suddenly transmigrated into a book, becoming the most despised adopted son of the Bai family in a novel about wealthy family power struggles—
The original host was an orphan, and just because of a single line from a fortune-teller said ‘his fate is hardy enough to ward off disaster,’ he had become the Bai family’s young master in name only.
The original host had a fine face but a timid, wooden-headed personality. He held the title of young master in name only; in reality, even the servants could bully him.
It was only after the family patriarch who held power passed away that the Bai family, for the sake of business interests, forcibly arranged for the original host to marry, under the pretext of a ‘luck-marriage,’ the comatose third young master of the Shang family, who had been in a car accident—
In less than a year, the original host was set up and used by others, dying senselessly in the Shang family’s power struggle.
Less than three days after Bai Xu transmigrated in, he found himself facing a full-blown forced-marriage scene.
Facing the various scheming, calculating members of the Bai family, Bai Xu glanced once more at the unconscious marriage partner on the hospital bed, then spoke up on his own:
“Marriage is, after all, a matter between two families. Since my future husband-to-be isn’t in a position to participate, why don’t you all just work out the bride price and dowry among yourselves and transfer it straight to my account.”
Caught off guard by his blunt talk of money, everyone present: “?”
Once the terms were settled and the hospital room door closed, Bai Xu immediately started humming happily to himself: “Tsk tsk tsk, good-looking but unconscious, rich family but no control over me. Where else could I find such a perfect, practically null and void, transparent marriage? Practically free money~”
Shang Yanxiao, who was faking unconsciousness: “……”
*
As the third young master of the Shang family, Shang Yanxiao had been a favored son of fortune since childhood, recognized by insiders in the capital’s social circles as the ‘heir of the Shang family’—until a carefully orchestrated car accident took his parents’ lives and left his younger brother disabled.
In order to lull the mastermind behind the accident into a false sense of security, and more importantly, to draw the snake out of its hole, Shang Yanxiao had no choice but to temporarily feign unconsciousness. He never expected that within a week he’d be forcibly saddled with a ‘luck-marriage’ union.
Shang Yanxiao had assumed his marriage partner wouldn’t last more than a few days before taking the money and running, but instead, the other party seemed to be thoroughly enjoying himself—
On one hand, he’d leave slacking, dismissive servants speechless with his retorts; on the other, he could charm the family patriarch who held power until the old master couldn’t stop smiling; he’d play innocent and foolish to lead the other Shang relatives around in circles, all while holding forth about investments to business partners on the phone.
Far from being unpleasant, he was actually rather likeable 🙂
*
To avoid following in the original host’s footsteps, Bai Xu spent his days working hard to earn his own money, occasionally ‘teasing’ his comatose husband to relieve stress—
“Ooh, these eyebrows are quite nice-shaped.”
“Tsk tsk, these earlobes feel pretty soft to the touch, hope he’s not the type to be whipped by his partner in the future.”
“Hm, these lips look pretty sexy, wonder how his kissing technique is though?”
“Whoa, these abs are pretty damn impressive, let me poke… poke—”
Shang Yanxiao, having reached the end of his patience: “Try poking one more time and see what happens.”
Bai Xu, frozen in shock: “Ah?”
Wait?
How did the luck-marriage actually end up working?

One day, Elk is forced to duel Rosho to decide the family’s successor, but the duel is a setup by the Duke family to execute him. In a twist of fate, Elk is left at death’s door. His soul drifts to a strange place known as the “Realm Between Life and Death”, where a god’s whim gives him a second chance to train himself anew.

She resolves: in this life, she will feed this warm family well and live a quiet and comfortable life. She will never associate with the powerful or the privileged. But thanks to her special cooking skills, her support group, and the lovely ‘Golden Swallow’ who protects her, she ends up getting entangled with a powerful family…

158833.synopsis:
In the world of horror movies, how can an ordinary person survive through layers of danger and make it to the end?
Thanks to all the horror movies she had watched before transmigrating, Everly summarized countless foolproof survival rules—
Horror Movie Survival Rule #1: Stay away from desolate ruins, campsites, castles, cabins in the woods, suspicious caves, or any similar locations.
So when her classmates enthusiastically invited her to explore a ruin, she firmly said no.
Those classmates never returned even by the time she graduated from middle school.
…
Horror Movie Survival Rule #2: Always know your escape routes wherever you go.
So when a killer suddenly appeared in the theater, she immediately slipped into the ventilation ducts, becoming one of the few survivors of the incident.
…
Horror Movie Survival Rule #3: Stick close to the protagonist.
Although this could sometimes make you a mere cannon fodder, in most cases it’s useful.
That’s why, even while injured, she was able to escape the pursuit of a cannibal and survive.
…
Everly didn’t know when any of this would end.
She only knew one thing: she wanted to live.
To live freely in a world full of evil gods, monsters, madmen, and death.
…
==
Transmigrating into a world of horror movies, though all the horror movies are made up by the author.
Roughly a story about how an ordinary person uses wisdom and caution to survive in a horror movie world, with a little “cheat” but not much.
The female lead is not a saint, not a perfect character, and has some moral flaws. If you mind, proceed with caution.

169585.synopsis:
When Ian opens his eyes, he finds himself in a world of wizards, now a wizard apprentice in the Emerald Shadow Forest.
At first, Ian—whose talent seems average—only wants to remain a lowly apprentice and survive peacefully in this dangerous world.
But he soon discovers something extraordinary.
Whenever he perfects a skill to its ultimate mastery, his talent improves.
There is no ceiling.
No limit.
From then on, every craft, every spell, every discipline becomes a stepping stone to greater potential.
Talent Ranks
Mortal Star Rank – Ordinary talent with the possibility of transcending mortality.
Silver Moon Rank – Entering the realm of the extraordinary; potential begins to show.
Radiant Sun Rank – Like a blazing sun illuminating all directions.
Law Rank – Born with the power of laws; favored by the world itself.
Sovereign Rank – Words shape reality; authority itself obeys their will.
Domain Rank – Lord of a plane; revered by all races.
Deep Space Rank – Walker between worlds; completely unrestrained.
Civilization Rank – Embodiment of civilization; illuminating countless worlds.
End Rank – The source of all existence; the final concept of reality.
associated_names: 巫师：满级天赋，从零环戏法开始

174449.synopsis:
[Taking Heat Suppressant Pills] 
Did my eyes just glitch?
“Hey! Wake up! Why’d you set your alarm so weird—…huh?”
When I opened my eyes, I had somehow become Seong Chanyeong, a dominant Omega villain from the BL novel my older sister was reading.
And his role?
A jealous antagonist who burns with inferiority toward the main bottom, Seo Eunsu… only to end up meeting a miserable fate at the hands of the tops.
At this rate, I’m doomed to get wiped out by the guys who love Seo Eunsu.
‘No way I’m dying like this!’
“…I’m sorry, Seo Eunsu. I sincerely want to apologize for everything I’ve done to you.”
“Huh?”
First, I go find the main character and apologize my ass off—
“Let’s break up starting today.”
“…Out of nowhere?”
“I don’t like you anymore. Let’s call off the engagement. You didn’t like me either, right?”
Then I dump Seong Chanyeong’s fiancé.
Block and delete every single top he used to cling to—and run.
Run where? Somewhere quiet, with clean water. The countryside.
What’s so great about being a villain chaebol bottom anyway?
I’ll just farm to my heart’s content and live peacefully.
So there I was, happily planting lettuce, buying strawberry seedlings, raising a mutt, living my best life when…
“So this is where you ran off to? To live like this? Seriously?”
The tops tracked me down.
And these guys—seriously.
Hey. You looking down on farming or what? ?

192113.synopsis:
Zhao Rong was supposed to be a transmigrator who remained detached from the plot, playing the role of a good-for-nothing young master to perfection, fulfilling his cannon fodder purpose before quietly exiting the stage.
But the hand Qiao Nanqi, the male lead, extended when Zhao Rong fell into the mud pulled him off the predetermined course of the story.
As a result, Zhao Rong completely disregarded the original plot and pursued Qiao Nanqi passionately for ten years, finally succeeding in winning him over.
However, after just one year of marriage, Qiao Nanqi deemed him rotten within, ignored all his efforts, remained cold and indifferent, frequently stayed out overnight, and never introduced him to his friends.
—He even had a noble white moonlight in his heart.
Zhao Rong suddenly woke up and decided to return to being a proper transmigrator, steering the plot back to its original course.
The first thing he did after divorcing Qiao Nanqi was to fulfill his original marriage arrangement.
The person he was arranged to marry was none other than… Qiao Nanqi’s white moonlight, who was supposed to end up with Zhao Rong, the good-for-nothing young master, in the original plot.
Three months later—
Zhao Rong, who had spent the night on the white moonlight’s sofa, walked out the door and bumped right into Qiao Nanqi, who had been standing outside all night.
As usual, Zhao Rong wrapped his arms around the man’s shoulders and whispered softly, “What, waiting for him?”
Qiao Nanqi pushed him against the wall and leaned close to his ear.
“I’m waiting for you.”
Zhao Rong’s eyes darkened, a smile devoid of warmth curling at the corners of his lips as he pushed him away. “Oh, but I’m not waiting for you anymore.”

199025.synopsis:
[Rebirth + Realistic Style + Escaping the Original Family + Making Money] 
Jiang Xue has been reborn, returning to the year 2007.
With a father who doesn’t care and a mother who doesn’t love her, she’s expected to go work on a factory assembly line!
Working in a factory? That’s never going to happen.
In 2007, the internet was still a barren wasteland; WeChat and Weibo had not yet launched. Relying on her makeup skills, she becomes a Tianya sensation, a celebrity makeup artist, a renowned photographer, the original influencer, and a top-tier sales queen.
Riding the wave of the era, she soars to the top.
Who says a girl has no home of her own once she grows up? She can buy herself ten or eight homes.
If you aren’t loved, then love yourself.
Only by standing high can you be seen.
The story focuses on her career and is plot-driven with a romantic subplot. While it isn’t a traditional power fantasy, the entrepreneurial journey is still incredibly satisfying! The female lead is a growth-oriented character in a story about female development and self-redemption. Already completed!
